items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: we went to many track meets together, and I learned to walk with him

ctx.x: But could he see well enough to see a track meet?

Well, he would go. He'd go to baseball games. No, he couldn't really see --he could not see the track meet, but we went to many track meets together, and I learned to walk with him. He didn't like for you to lead him by the hand, and so when we'd go to track meets, I'd wear this white shirt and I'd get right in front of him ... and he saw a little, so he could see this glare, you know, and he would never stumble or anything, but when we saw the pole vault this day, I remember he was up before everyone.
